title: Europe Focus! Bratislava LZIB & Borkenberge EDLB | MSFS 2020 Marketplace
description:
Are you looking to expand your European route network in Microsoft Flight Simulator this week, or are you trying to avoid impulse buys on the storefront? Today, we break down a focused European duo of brand-new airport releases on the MSFS 2020 Marketplace—spanning Slovakia's primary international capital gateway down to a charming grassroots gliding and sport aviation airfield nestled in the German countryside.

To help you decide what fits your flight logs and storage budget, we inspect these new Marketplace additions and detail what each developer brings to the platform:

🇸🇰 COMMERCIAL GATEWAYS: BRATISLAVA AIRPORT LZIB (FLYING PARTNERS SLOVAKIA)
We inspect the capital gateway of the Slovak Republic, M. R. Štefánik Airport (LZIB). Modeled by Flying Partners Slovakia (FPS) using recent photo documentation, satellite imagery, and AIP chart data, this rendition captures the ongoing real-world terminal and apron reconfigurations. We evaluate the passenger terminal exterior and modeled interior (including security checkpoints), airside bus and emergency vehicle detailing, custom ATC tower with 3D cabin views, and apron surroundings to see if this is the definitive Central European hub your airliner fleet needs.

🇩🇪 GRASSROOTS & SPORT AVIATION: BORKENBERGE AIRFIELD EDLB (SPINOZA)
We head into the North Rhine-Westphalia countryside to tour Flugplatz Borkenberge (EDLB). Operated by the Borkenberge Society, this popular recreational field caters to glider pilots, flight schools, and light GA touring. We take a look at Spinoza's modeling of the airfield buildings, custom control tower interior, surrounding spectator areas and playgrounds, static glider arrangements, and custom ground aircraft density options—while assessing ramp spawn layout details.

Whether you are spooling up twin jets on scheduled commercial runs into Bratislava or practicing low-and-slow glider approaches and VFR circuits around Borkenberge, we evaluate this ramp inspection to help you decide what truly deserves a spot in your simulator installation.

If you enjoy honest, clear, and critical looks at the Flight Simulator Marketplace without the fluff, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and drop a comment below! Which of these European airfields are you adding to your hangar first?
